eligibility: Be an international student starting your first year of a Canadian post-secondary institution
Be an international student starting the first year of a full-time 4-year, or 5-year co-op, undergraduate degree at Toronto Metropolitan University
Be required to pay international tuition fees
Have a final admission average of at least 86%, an A, or an equivalent
Be enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time
If a gap year was taken, it must be no longer than one academic year
Hold International Visa student status and authorization at the time of registration and during the semester in which the award begins
Have first-class standing and not have previously been in attendance at a Canadian post-secondary institution on a full-time basis
existing.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate international students who are starting their first year at a Canadian post-secondary institution on a full-time basis, are required to pay international tuition fees, and hold a final admission average of at least 86%, an A, or an equivalent. Any gap year taken must be no longer than one academic year.
benefits: Up to 53 recipients for ISLA - Fall 2027
coverage: Up to 53 recipients for ISLA - Fall 2027
requirements: Write a personal statement for submission
Apply through the AwardSpring portal once the fall 2027 awards application opens on November 2, 2026
Have received a TMU Student Number and activated online identity to access AwardSpring, although applicants are eligible to apply before receiving an offer of admission
Submit before the extended deadline of February 16, 2027, as the form closes promptly at 11:59 p.m. ET
application_method: Register and start, or use an existing, TMU Student Number and activate the online identity
Log on to AwardSpring at torontomu.awardspring.ca
Complete the general application and then the ISLA follow-up components, including the personal statement
Submit before the deadline, monitoring email and the ChooseTMU Applicant Portal for decisions
existing.selection_notes: The award targets international students who do well academically, volunteer, join clubs and show leadership qualities. Number of recipients is capped at 53 for fall 2027.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving international undergraduates with 86% or better final admission averages who can document volunteering, club involvement and leadership.
existing.notes: ISLA - Fall and ISLA - Winter are separate awards with separate deadlines; the ISLA - Winter 2027 deadline was September 14, 2026 and had already passed at the verification date, and the fall deadline explicitly does not apply to ISLA - Winter. The award is entrance-only and non-renewable.
existing.application_period: The application for fall 2027 awards is available on AwardSpring from November 2, 2026 until the extended deadline of February 16, 2027. The form closes promptly at 11:59 p.m. ET and applications are not accepted past the deadline under any circumstances, including technical difficulties.
existing.deadline_display: February 16, 2027 (extended deadline). The fall 2027 awards application opens on AwardSpring on November 2, 2026
